description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy achieved by different attributes on a multi-retrieval task, with a sample size of n=2. The horizontal axis represents the model—Qwen2.5-7b-1M, Interlm3-8b, and Qwen2.5-7b—and is labeled accordingly, with the models listed in an unspecified order. The vertical axis represents accuracy, labeled as “Accuracy by different attributes on multi-retrieval task,” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 20-unit intervals. Six grouped bars are presented for each model, representing the attributes “city” (teal), “hobby” (coral), “university” (lavender), “major” (pink), and “birthdate” (lime green). Within each model grouping, the bars are arranged in the order listed in the legend. For Qwen2.5-7b-1M, the accuracy values are approximately 74, 82, 84, 70, 62, and 28 for “city”, “hobby”, “university”, “major”, “birthdate”, respectively. For Interlm3-8b, the accuracy values are approximately 78, 84, 80, 66, 58, and 12 for “city”, “hobby”, “university”, “major”, “birthdate”, respectively. For Qwen2.5-7b, the accuracy values are approximately 82, 80, 78, 64, 60, and 16 for “city”, “hobby”, “university”, “major”, “birthdate”, respectively. No bars are visually emphasized.
